title: One-time initialization that can retry
summary: Publish a shared value after the first successful initialization and let another caller retry after an exception.
triggers: lazy initialization shared by concurrent C++ callers
std::call_once retries after an initializer throws
prompts: Load a shared configuration on first access without letting multiple callers perform the successful load.
Let an initialization error reach the caller and allow the next caller to try again.
invariant: Callers read the value only after one initializer returns successfully. All subsequent successful callers observe that value.
mantra: Publish on success, propagate failure, allow a retry.
pitfalls: Swallowing the loader exception inside call_once would mark the flag complete even if initialization failed.
The loader must tolerate retrying any effects it performs before throwing. It must not call get recursively on the same object.
A once flag has no reset operation. The returned reference is valid only while its owner is alive.
